description: Use when you need what regulators have done about traded compute. Lists regulator actions and due dates on compute derivatives since a date, newest first, with sources. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

limit.description: Most rows to return, newest first. At most 100.

regulator.description: Only actions by one regulator, by short name or full name, for example CFTC.

since.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. Actions and due dates on or after this date.

name: list-regulator-actions
title: Regulator actions on traded compute
